parameters.name: UserMFAAuthenticationSettings
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable MFA for the user. Valid values:

*   Enabled: enables MFA for the user.
*   Disabled: disables MFA for the user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso update-user-mfa-authentication-settings --user-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --user-mfa-authentication-settings Enabled --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --region cn-hangzhou
